inputs.name: hand over from Production Drift Monitoring to Alerting System

output.level_0: The drift monitor crashes nightly, so no alert ever reaches the on call engineer.
output.level_1: No alerting system exists, so drift findings sit in a log nobody reads.
output.level_2: A human checks the drift dashboard each morning and emails the team if numbers look odd.
output.level_3: The system automatically pages the on call engineer when drift metrics cross the threshold.
output.level_4: Alerts trigger with full audit trails, ensuring every drift response is documented for compliance.
